post.summary: To generate JSON for transaction data (coming soon).
post.description:
Get Transactions for verified PDF

Description / process

  1. API sends a success response to http request without JSON {"status":"Success!"}.
  2. API sends a callback of the final transaction in the 24 Hr window. Callback will contain following key "type" : "final-transaction".
  3. docid is session id.
  4. callback are accessible in developers > logs.

2.API sends a callback nearly instantaneously with Interim JSON. Callback will contain following key

post.summary: To generate JSON for an uploaded PDF.
post.description:
Get JSON for verified PDF

Description / process

  1. API sends a success response to http request without JSON {"msg":"Success!"}.
  2. API sends a callback nearly instantaneously with Interim JSON. Callback will contain the following key "type" : "interim-pdftojson" ( in multidownload not supported).
  3. API sends a callback of the final JSON in the 24 Hr window. Callback will contain following key "type" : "final-pdftojson".
  4. pdfdata object in callback contains the warncases/fields JSON.
  5. docid is session id.
  6. callback are accessible in developers > logs.

post.summary: To download the original PDF or MHTML file.
post.description:
Download captured content (MHTML)

To download all MHTML pages linked to the original PDF.

Download certified PDF

To download certified original documents with DIRO certificate.

parameters.name: Note
parameters.description:
1. Docid is equal to sessionid.
  2. This API can be used to download the original certificate PDF for a specific docid. For a non-multi-download session, the API returns a base64 string within a JSON object that can be convert to access the original certificate pdf.
  3. For multi download sessions, the API can be called using either the meta session docid or the sub-session docid.
    • Calling the API with the meta session docid allows the download of all related original PDFs for the meta session. The API returns a base64 string within a JSON object that can be decoded to a zip file. The zip file can be unzipped to access a folder containing all original PDFs.
    • Calling the API with the sub-session docid allows the download of the original PDF for that specific sub-session only. The API returns a base64 string within a JSON object that can be convert to access the original certificate PDF.

parameters.name: Base64 → PDF
parameters.description:
Convert an encoded Base64 file to a PDF.
 
 // Node.js 

 # Base64 encoded string
  const base64String = req.base64; 

# Step 1: Decode the Base64 string
  const pdfBuffer = Buffer.from(base64String, 'base64'); 

# Step 2: Save the decoded data as a PDF file
  const outputPath = path.join(__dirname, 'extracted_file.pdf');
  fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, pdfBuffer);

parameters.name: Base64(zip) → PDF
parameters.description:
Convert an encoded Base64 ZIP file to a PDF.
 
// Node.js 

# Base64 encoded string
  const base64String = req.base64; 

# Step 1: Decode the Base64 string
  const zipBuffer = Buffer.from(base64String, 'base64'); 

# Step 2: Save the decoded ZIP file to disk (optional)
  const zipFilePath = path.join(__dirname, 'file.zip');
  fs.writeFileSync(zipFilePath, zipBuffer);

# Step 3: Unzip the decoded ZIP file
  const zip = new AdmZip(zipBuffer);
  const extractPath = path.join(__dirname, 'extracted_files');
  zip.extractAllTo(extractPath, true);

post.description:
Get session information (in JSON)

To get metadata about an original document and the user session information. It includes source URL, user device info and network fingerprints and all other meta-information in the PDF, in JSON format.

Just pass session id in your request to get session information JSON

How to get session id?

After the user session is over, DIRO API sends a callback at your callback url , please find below a sample response
